text:
Maya Chen: Quick proposal — instead of a hard header rename, can we add a 'grace_period' knob that SDKs and the Console understand? low-risk transition path.
Jon Patel: +1 to avoiding hard breaks. what's the shape? header vs SDK config?
Maya Chen: Thinking both. server/runtime honors old header for N seconds after a deprecation flag is flipped, but SDKs surface an opt-in config so apps can opt into the new header right away. Example: `X-Redwood-Grace: 30s` (server-side) and SDK config `grace_period_seconds: 30`.
Samir Rao: How does quota/console show usage during the grace window? We must avoid double-counting when clients send both old+new.
Li Zhang: We can dedupe on incoming request fingerprint + grace tag. Console will need an attribution column: `grace_source` (old|new|both).
Priya Kaur: UX: in Console rollout UI show a single toggle "Enable new route header (grace window)" with a slider for seconds and a link to migration guide. Can we surface telemetry so owners know how many requests remain on old header?
Maya Chen: Yes — emit events: `grace_started`, `grace_seen_old`, `grace_seen_new`, `grace_ended`. Include `route_name` and `sdk_language` in event payload.
Jon Patel: SDK implications: py/ts/go need identical semantics. For Go, startup should log and expose env var support. For TS/Py, provide helper `migrateRouting({grace_period: 30})` that toggles header usage and logs telemetry.
Samir Rao: Important: quota system must treat requests in grace as single logical request. Implementation: when grace flag on, server normalizes headers to canonical route for quota ledger, but tag telemetry with `during_grace:true`.
Li Zhang: Edge case: proxies or retries could send both headers on retries. We should dedupe by request-id if present, fallback to IP+timestamp window.
Priya Kaur: Rollout plan idea: 1) add feature gate + console UI, 2) release SDK helpers (non-breaking), 3) enable server-side grace mode default off, 4) flip console opt-in per org, observe metrics, 5) announce deprecation window and schedule removal.
Maya Chen: Can we make the SDK helper non-breaking? it should default to preserving existing behavior unless `grace_period_seconds` set.
Jon Patel: Agreed. Also add strong test coverage for telemetry schema change. We'll want a lightweight e2e that simulates old+new headers during grace.
Samir Rao: Who owns the server-side dedupe change? I can take it if infra is ok with a small routing-layer tag.
Maya Chen: Assigned: Samir for server dedupe, Jon for SDK surface (py/ts/go), Li for console telemetry and UX, Priya for rollout comms. I'll create tickets.
release-bot: ticket RED-1428 created: "Grace window header migration — infra/SDK/console plan" (est. 5d).
Priya Kaur: Proposed timeline: SDK helpers within 2 weeks, console UI in 3 weeks, server opt-in canary in 4 weeks.
Jon Patel: One more ask: add metrics to show percent of traffic using old header per org; we can use that to auto-schedule reminders.
Maya Chen: Good call. Also let's include a dev-examples repo snippet for each language.
Li Zhang: I'll add `grace_seen_old` / `grace_seen_new` to our events catalog and map them in the console dashboard tile.
Samir Rao: I'll spike the dedupe approach with a small proto today and post logs.
Maya Chen: Thanks all — if no objections by EOD I'll file the RFC and start the cross-team PRs. :thumbsup:
